tamedaiplus-guide-text: Taming guide: General General This mod is a forked version of animalAI by G3rste, and attempts to enhance and update their mod. Animal trackers Your tamed animals appear on the map with waypoints under the waypoints category (Will try to get this under the 'Owned creatures' tab so it becomes a toggle). The waypoint turns red when a animal is downed, and the color restores when it heals. Breeding and caging are also tracked. You can see each animal's name, and current location at a glance, making it easy to keep tabs on your entire pack even when they are spread across a large area. Complex commands animals start with simple commands (Sit, Lay, Speak) that require little obedience. As your bond grows, four complex commands unlock: Follow: Your animal follows you everywhere and can fight along side you depending on the chosen behaviour. Stay: Your animal stays arround the command point. If it wanders more than 10 blocks away, it returns automatically. Roam: Your animal roams freely with no fixed position, exploring its surroundings. This is the default behavior. Guard: Your animal roams within a 50-block radius of the command point. If it strays further, it returns. Ideal for base defense. Animal beds Animal cushions are decorative beds your buddy's sometimes sleep in. Available in small, medium and large with many colors. Place one down and your animal may curl up in it when resting. They serve no mechanical purpose but add a cozy touch to your home. Animal ID You can view a detailed profile for each of your tamed animals by opening its command GUI. The profile shows the animal's name, animal type, current generation, size, and allows you to toggle breeding or abandon the animal. animals are identified by name tags and their owner is displayed in the profile.
feverstonehorses:horsetamingguide-text: A Guide to Horse Taming: -----by Verlia For those wanting the vanilla taming and saddlebreaking experience, it will still work as well! Taming a horse is fairly simple! First, you will need to find a food that horses will enjoy! Dry grass is a good start, but other foods will be preferred. Try out a variety! Right clicking a wild horse with a compatible food item will start the taming process. Each feeding will increase taming percentage until the process is complete. Now you can name your new horse! Feeding your horse after taming is complete will increase its obedience, so when you give it a command it will be more inclined to listen. --Now you'll need to equip it!-- Each breed has their own saddle, bridle, and saddlebags. You'll need at least bronze to make nails and strips for certain craftables! Now that your horse is equipped, mount up on your new horse by right clicking on the Selection Box above the saddle. An empty hand is needed. Dismount your horse by pressing the sneak key. Horses can eat from troughs and breed just like other domesticated animals. Some of their favorite foods are carrots, apples, and grains, and each will affect them differently! Keep an eye out for more attachments in the future!
